body: 2026-06-14: Deleted apps/playground entirely; moved Gallery/Playground/MonacoPane/RenderedDoc/ThemeToggle/PlaygroundApp + examples + adapters into apps/website/src/playground/. /demo route renders <PlaygroundApp/>. __root.tsx detects /demo and skips Header+Footer so the playground gets the full viewport (it brings its own header/footer). Reasons: (1) the textarea+MDXViewer stub at /demo was visibly worse than the existing playground — user feedback 'it sucks'; (2) one playground source-of-truth instead of two; (3) no separate vercel deploy URL to maintain; (4) the live marketing site IS the live demo of the product. Trade-offs accepted: marketing-site bundle grew due to Monaco editor; the sample datagrid example references a remote CSV (cdn.wsform.com) that browsers CORS-block from any origin — pre-existing playground behavior, surfaces as a console error but the doc still renders. Live at khanakia.com/apps/filemark/demo.
title: Merged apps/playground into apps/website/src/playground; /demo IS the real playground
